verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing pages describe custom automations and rules that move work forward, plus automation that keeps Jira up to date across connected tools, so the product itself offers automation rules. The evidence is thin marketing copy, though, and never documents the trigger-and-action rule builder. Missing for 10: documentation of trigger types, conditions and action types; any description of the rule-building interface; independent or hands-on corroboration that rules eliminate manual steps.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
Connect your tools to any Jira workflow with automation. Whether your team is using Bitbucket, Slack, or any other tool, automation keeps Jira up to date, so you don't have to.
